banner.title: Stage 2 complete — resting before Guyot
banner.body: Colorado Trail done at 00:47. 42.7 miles and 5,984 feet, six and a half hours of riding — faster than the seven and a quarter planned. The extra hours were the afternoon weather hold at the house, not the pace. Resting now before stage 3, Mount Guyot, which climbs French Pass at sunrise. Tracking has been solid since the messenger was remounted: every fix arrived on cadence through the whole of stage 2.
